## Summary

Adds the evidence-first proposal for the Agent Behavior Trace Model, presented and agreed at the September 30 meeting, as `working-documents/AGENT-BEHAVIOR-TRACE-MODEL-EVIDENCE-FIRST.md`. The text is the version in the WG working document, converted to Markdown, with a status line added.

## Related Issue

Updates #40. Records the decision that the revised execution plan (#60) implements.

## Review Notes

This is the document as presented, kept as a record of the decision. Please check that the conversion matches the working document.

Suggested review window: 1 week (living documents).

## Follow-ups

The October 14 gaps update and the October 28 turn proposal follow in their own pull requests.
